paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.17% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+1.19%) and Hang Seng weakest (-2.60%). Brent crude changed -0.06% to 102.25. Gold changed -0.95% to 4,162.2998. Bitcoin changed +0.15% to 84,621.0625. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.277%, a relative move of +0.76%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (+3.98%) and Glencore (+2.95%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: EG Group delays IPO plans and draws takeover interest (FT Markets). Petrol station empire had filed for New York listing aiming to raise about $1bn at $9bn valuation Deals and capital markets: Goldman bought Shein shares worth $220mn after dismal IPO (FT Markets). Shares in fast-fashion retailer have tumbled 38% since listing in Hong Kong last month Central banks and macro: Eurozone inflation hits three-year high of 3.8% (FT Home). Consumer prices rose at higher rate than expected in September Central banks and macro: Quant hedge funds reap big gains from global bond sell-off (FT Markets). Trend-following portfolios have latched on to sharp rise in yields this year as Iran war and strong US economic data fuel inflation fears Geopolitics and trade: Arctic sea routes boom as Gulf war and global warming divert shipping (FT Markets). Transits via Northern Sea Route quadruple as melting ice makes journey more passable and vessels avoid the Middle East
